text: The data breach described has a severe impact due to the highly sensitive nature of the compromised information. The exposure of medical histories and treatment information violates patient privacy and can lead to significant emotional distress and discrimination. Furthermore, the inclusion of patient names and health insurance details creates a high risk for financial crimes, specifically identity theft and insurance fraud, affecting 200,000 individuals. This combination of protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII) amplifies the potential for long-term harm to the affected patients.
